items.title: Bespoke OLAP: Using AI to Synthesize Workload-Specific DBMS Engines from Scratch
items.raw_excerpt: Every modern OLAP engine pays a hidden performance tax: the cost of being general-purpose. What if we could let AI build a database engine for exactly your workload, from scratch, in a few hours? We introduce Bespoke OLAP, a fully autonomous synthesis pipeline that uses LLM-guided code generation to produce complete, workload-specific C++ database engines, achieving 11.78x total speedup over DuckDB on TPC-H.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 亚洲开发银行（ADB）10日发布《2026年亚洲发展展望（4月版）》报告，上调韩国今年经济增长预期0.2个百分点至1.9%，明年增长预期也为1.9%。亚行上调预期的依据包括半导体业绩向好拉动出口增长，降息节奏放缓助推消费提振效果有望在今年释放，政府或扩大半导体、军工、生物等战略产业相关开支。亚行同时认为韩国经济还面临着不少不确定性，如中东冲突、美国关税政策等外部风险，以及人工智能（AI）需求难测、半导体周期波动频繁等带来的下行压力。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) released its "Asian Development Outlook 2026 (April Edition)" on April 10, revising South Korea's economic growth forecast for this year upward by 0.2 percentage points to 1.9%, with the same growth expected for next year. The ADB based its revised forecast on improved semiconductor performance boosting exports, a slower pace of interest rate cuts potentially stimulating consumption, and possible increased government spending on strategic industries such as semiconductors, defense, and biotechnology. However, the ADB also notes several uncertainties facing the South Korean economy, including external risks like conflicts in the Middle East and U.S. tariff policies, as well as downward pressures from unpredictable AI demand and frequent fluctuations in the semiconductor cycle.
excerpt_i18n.es: El Banco Asiático de Desarrollo (BAD) publicó el 10 de abril el informe "Perspectivas de Desarrollo en Asia 2026", donde ha revisado al alza las previsiones de crecimiento económico de Corea del Sur para este año en 0,2 puntos porcentuales hasta el 1,9%, y mantiene la misma tasa para el próximo año. Las razones para esta revisión incluyen un mejor rendimiento de los semiconductores que impulsa las exportaciones, un ritmo más lento de reducción de tipos de interés que podría estimular el consumo este año, y un posible aumento de los gastos gubernamentales en industrias estratégicas como semiconductores, defensa y biotecnología. Sin embargo, el BAD también señala que la economía surcoreana enfrenta varias incertidumbres, como los conflictos en Oriente Medio, las políticas arancelarias de Estados Unidos, y la volatilidad de la demanda de inteligencia artificial (IA) y del ciclo de semiconductores.

The 2026 XPeng MONA M03 has officially launched. This event, themed around youth, appears to be an annual update of a key model but subtly reveals a strategic shift within the XPeng Group. Behind the name change: Transition from "car manufacturing" to a "physical AI technology group"

He emphasized that this is not just a brand adjustment but a redefinition of the industry's essence and the company's positioning—shifting from a focus on new energy hardware competition to a new era characterized by "new energy + intelligent entities + physical AI."

He Xiaopeng explicitly stated that over the years, external suggestions have been made to change the "XPeng" name, but the decision to drop "automobile" signifies a fundamental expansion of the company's core business scope. In the past decade, XPeng's focus was on intelligent EVs; for the next decade, the focus will be on physical AI, which involves using large models as a foundation to enable perception, understanding, decision-making, and execution in the physical world through vehicles, robots, flying cars, and other physical carriers.

This judgment is supported by his understanding of the technological pace.

items.raw_excerpt: 作者 | 杨依婷 编辑 | 包永刚 去年的CFMS｜MemoryS峰会上，存储厂商们讨论的是：价格何时企稳、QLC何时上量、AI PC何时落地。彼时，“AI会让存储变得更基础、更关键”，还更像是一种行业判断，一种面向未来的趋势预演。 一年之后，站在MemoryS 2026的会场里，问题已经彻底变了。 人们谈论的不再只是位元成本、颗粒供给和容量节奏，而是GPU利用率、token成本、系统调度效率，甚至物理AI场景中的实时决策能力。那些原本属于AI基础设施和系统架构层面的议题，正在越来越频繁地出现在存储产业的讨论中心。 在传统计算架构里，存储的职责更多是“存”。数据被写入、留存，在需要时调取，不需要时则静静停留在系统边缘。它长期是BOM成本中的一项，是容量规划的问题，而很少直接参与算力效率的定义。 但在大模型训练与推理时代，这一角色被彻底改写。 KV Cache的访问延迟，开始直接影响token生成速率；Checkpoint的写入效率，决定着GPU在训练过程中的等待时间；SSD的IOPS密度，则进一步影响大模型推理场景下的并发能力和系统吞吐。 存储开始进入计算主路径，它决定数据流动的速度，也在某种程度上决定GPU算力能否被充分兑现。而这，正在反向重塑整个存储产业链的分工逻辑。 存储进入计算路径，旧分工开始失效 AI推理有一个被反复讨论的瓶颈：KV Cache。 大模型在处理长上下文时，需要把每一层、每一个token生成过程中的Key和Value结果临时保存下来，以避免重复计算。上下文越长，并发越高，这部分缓存的体量就越惊人。 当高带宽显存无法继续承接，KV Cache只能向下一层存储介质下沉，NVMe SSD由此正式进入大模型推理的实时数据路径。 如果说过去SSD的使命是“提升加载速度”，那么在AI时代，它开始直接约束或决定推理吞吐的上限。 慧荣科技总经理苟嘉章的总结更为直接：

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Yang Yiting Editor: Bao Yonggang

At last year's CFMS | MemoryS Summit, storage manufacturers discussed when prices would stabilize, when QLC would scale up, and when AI PCs would be realized. At that time, the idea that "AI will make storage more fundamental and critical" was more of an industry prediction, a preview of future trends.

A year later, at the MemoryS 2026 conference, the questions have completely changed. Discussions no longer focus solely on bit costs, chip supply, and capacity schedules, but also on GPU utilization, token costs, system scheduling efficiency, and even real-time decision-making capabilities in physical AI scenarios. Issues originally belonging to AI infrastructure and system architecture are increasingly appearing at the center of storage industry discussions.

In traditional computing architectures, the role of storage has primarily been to "store." Data is written, retained, and retrieved when needed, otherwise remaining idle at the periphery of the system. It has long been an item in the BOM cost, a matter of capacity planning, and rarely directly involved in defining computational efficiency.

However, in the era of large model training and inference, this role has been completely rewritten. The access latency of KV Cache now directly affects token generation rates; the write efficiency of Checkpoints determines the waiting time of GPUs during training; and the IOPS density of SSDs further influences concurrency and system throughput in large model inference scenarios. Storage is now entering the main path of computation, determining the speed of data flow.

Entonces, la idea de que "la IA haría que el almacenamiento sea más básico y crucial" parecía más una evaluación del sector, una previsión futura. Un año después, en el MemoryS 2026, las preguntas han cambiado por completo. Ya no se habla solo de costos de bits, suministro de chips y ritmo de capacidad, sino de la utilización de GPUs, costos de tokens, eficiencia de programación del sistema e incluso la capacidad de toma de decisiones en tiempo real en escenarios físicos de IA. As the founder of the new company, Li Di still speaks with evident fondness when mentioning the AI product he built from scratch. Known as the "father of Xiaoice," this identity has been Li Di's most prominent label, and it's a product to which he devoted over a decade. However, everything took a sharp turn after the Spring Festival of 2025—first, he was relieved of his duties in February, and then in late November, the core product X Eva was officially discontinued, forcing Xiaoice into a dormant phase. This was not a graceful exit. Li Di, along with a core team, pivoted to the intelligent entity track in December 2025, making their debut at Ji Qi's Jiqi Creation Forum under the name "Tomorrow's New Journey." The team remains small, with fewer than twenty members. We met Li Di twice in Wudaokou, once at the end of 2025 and again at the beginning of 2026. Reflecting on the past, Li Di tries to view and let go of it as an observer, but he still self-deprecates and harbors some regret—"The only thing I truly regret is not developing a reasoning model at the end of 2023." In his recollection, each technical decision corresponds to a window of opportunity: "I may have just lost a name, but Xiaoice lost a year and a half to two years." From this perspective, Xiaoice's growth trajectory, as well as the divergences and choices at critical junctures, take on another layer of interpretation. "El padre de Xiaoice" es la etiqueta más conocida de Li Di y el producto AI al que dedicó más de diez años, pero todo cambió drásticamente después del Año Nuevo Chino de 2025: primero fue destituido en febrero, y luego en noviembre su producto central X Eva cesó sus servicios, forzando a Xiaoice a entrar en un período de letargo. No fue una despedida digna, Li Di se llevó consigo un equipo central.

items.raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包APP实时语音通话功能升级，上线全双工语音大模型Seeduplex 。据介绍，作为原生全双工端到端语音大模型，Seeduplex 能够在复杂声学场景下实现精准抗干扰与动态判停，提供更顺畅、更自然的语音交互体验。 此次更新后，豆包实时语音通话功能在对话自然度、响应速度和抗干扰能力等方面均有提升。 记者实测发现，升级后的豆包语音通话在复杂环境下表现出较强的抗干扰能力，即便周围存在人声和噪音干扰，也能较准确地识别用户语音，不易被无关声音带偏。以餐厅、展览等易出现多人交谈的场景为例，过往 AI 产品容易因背景噪音或旁人说话声出现误打断、误回复等情况；此次升级后，豆包对无关声音的过滤能力有所增强，对话过程也更不容易被人声意外打断。 除抗干扰能力外，升级后的语音对话节奏也更接近自然交流。人与人对话中，停顿并不总意味着发言结束。此次升级后，豆包可结合语音与语义信息判断用户是否仍在继续表达，从而减少对话中的“抢话”现象。与此同时，对话响应时延也进一步降低，在接龙、飞花令等高频互动场景中表现更为明显。 目前，这一能力已在豆包 APP上线。用户可点击“打电话”按钮，开启实时语音通话功能体验。 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the Doudou app has upgraded its real-time voice call feature with the launch of the full-duplex voice model Seeduplex. As a native full-duplex end-to-end voice model, Seeduplex can achieve precise interference resistance and dynamic pause detection in complex acoustic environments, providing a smoother and more natural voice interaction experience. After this update, the Doudou real-time voice call function has improved in conversation naturalness, response speed, and interference resistance. Journalists found that the upgraded Doudou voice calls demonstrate strong interference resistance in complex environments, accurately identifying user voices even with surrounding noise. In scenarios like restaurants or exhibitions where multiple conversations occur, past AI products often misinterpreted background noise or bystander speech, leading to interruptions or incorrect responses. With this upgrade, Doudou's ability to filter out irrelevant sounds has improved, making conversations less likely to be interrupted by external voices. Besides interference resistance, the upgraded voice dialogue now flows more naturally. In human conversations, pauses do not always indicate the end of a statement. The updated Doudou can now judge whether the user is still speaking by combining voice and semantic information, reducing instances of "talking over" in conversations. Additionally, the response latency has been further reduced, particularly noticeable in high-frequency interactive scenarios such as word games. This capability is now available on the Doudou app. Users can click the "Make a Call" button to start the real-time voice call feature.

items.title: Our response to the Axios developer tool compromise
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI responds to the Axios supply chain attack by rotating macOS code signing certificates, updating apps, and confirming no user data was compromised.

title_i18n.en: Our response to the Axios developer tool compromise

title_i18n.es: Nuestra respuesta a la vulneración de la herramienta de desarrolladores Axios

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI responds to the Axios supply chain attack by rotating macOS code signing certificates, updating apps, and confirming no user data was compromised.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI 对 Axios 供应链攻击的回应是轮换 macOS 代码签名证书、更新应用程序，并确认没有用户数据被泄露。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI responde al ataque a la cadena de suministro de Axios rotando los certificados de firma de código de macOS, actualizando las aplicaciones y confirmando que no se comprometió ningún dato de usuario.
